item.title: Indiana high school baseball teams shine in regional rankings
item.description: Indiana has seven high school baseball programs ranked in the top 25 of Perfect Game's Ohio Valley High School Rankings, with Center Grove leading the way at No. 4 overall.

item.title: Man sentenced to 30 years for shooting pregnant wife, feticide
item.description: Jeremy McBride was sentenced to 30 years in prison for the attempted murder of his pregnant wife and the feticide of her unborn baby.

item.title: Man receives 70-year sentence for 2022 murder in Indianapolis
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — A man has been sentenced to 70 years in prison after his conviction in a 2022 fatal shooting on the city’s east side, according to the Marion County Prosecutor’s Office. item.title: Butler snaps 6-game losing streak with 93-89 win over Georgetown
item.description: Butler snapped a six-game losing streak with a 93-89 victory against Georgetown, led by Finley Bizjack's 19 points and six assists.

item.title: Hundreds gather for vigil to honor fallen Beech Grove officer
item.description: Hundreds of people from across central Indiana gathered for a candlelight vigil to honor fallen officer Brian Elliott of the Beech Grove Police Department. He was fatally shot while responding to a domestic call. The crowd paid their respects to the man who risked his life to protect the Marion County, Indiana, community.

item.title: 4 teens arrested after traffic stop in Carmel reveals guns, marijuana
item.description: Four teenagers were taken into custody after a traffic stop in Carmel, Indiana, led to the discovery of marijuana and several firearms, including a handgun modified into a fully automatic machine gun.

item.title: Monitoring severe storm risk Thursday, much colder into this weekend | Feb. 18, 2026
item.description: Central and southern Indiana is at risk for severe storms Thursday afternoon-evening with a Level 2/5 risk, while Friday will be cooler and windier with mostly sunny skies, and the weekend will bring even colder air with highs in the mid 30s to low 40s.

item.title: Indianapolis Zoo president and CEO takes leave of absence
item.description: Robert W. Shumaker, the president and CEO of the Indianapolis Zoo, has taken a leave of absence. Meanwhile, John Gullion, the senior vice president of zoo operations, has been promoted to chief operating officer.
